svg.title: Figure 3. Evolved outcomes versus task-specific duplicate-execution clouds
svg.desc: Nineteen task-level clouds of six equivalent no-context outcomes with three evolved architecture outcomes overlaid.
svg.text: Figure 3. Evolved outcomes versus task-specific duplicate-execution clouds
Six byte-identical no-context requests define each gray cloud; Minimal/scikit-learn is the only evolved result outside a cloud.
Maximum |Δ| uses 15 dependent pairwise label deltas; descriptive reference, not a formal significance test.
